purpose: Evidence screening for glycemic load recomputation on changed F25 A2 recipes. Matched human GI methodology only; no ingredient category analogy.

globalRules.gk: Do not multiply recipe total CHO by GI from one other food. Require source-consistent ingredient GI measurement and reviewed method, or explicit bound omission per project GK policy.
globalRules.lowOmission: 1g max per serving for eligible low GI-missing minor ingredient, subject to evidence; never guess high-carbohydrate starch GI.
globalRules.sourceVersion: Current historical nutrition/GK input hashes are not automatically valid for water, product and cooking method changes.

nextAction: Candidate product selection -> new source and food-record evidence -> cooking technique consistency -> exact human GI literature matching -> calculate source version -> independent review -> new release PR
